name: tenshoku-facilitator
style: OUTLINE-ONLY line art. Every shape is drawn with thin gold contour lines and is COMPLETELY UNFILLED: the flat deep-navy background (#0e1024) shows through inside every body, garment, face, object, bubble and the ground ellipse. No filled areas, no solid shapes, no shading, no gradients, no hatching, no silhouettes, no colored bodies — if you would fill a shape, leave it empty instead. Single line weight throughout, minimal and refined, plenty of empty space, a thin gold ground ellipse under the scene drawn as an outline only. Exactly one element glows softly in emerald green; everything else is gold line only. FACES ARE COMPLETELY BLANK — no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth, no ears on anyone; the head is an empty outline with only the hairline and headwear. Every figure is seen in clean side profile or from behind; never a forward-facing face. STRICT: no text, no letters, no numbers, no glyphs anywhere, no sun or large glowing disc, one calm scene, no collage, no split panels. Match the reference images exactly in drawing technique: same thin unfilled gold contours, same empty navy interiors, same colour balance.

items.prompt: Fantasy 'coach / trainer' job class in a medieval European world (きづきくみたてファシリテーター — a facilitator who sparks awareness, then builds it into change). A standing figure in side profile at the edge of a small round table, one open hand raised in a gentle question. Wearing a short belted tunic, cropped trousers, cross-laced boots and a visor with a curved brim and open top — no robe, no cowl, and NO towel on the shoulder. Around the table sit exactly THREE YOUNG participants (count them: three seated figures, no more, no fewer) — teenagers or young students, slight builds, smaller than the standing trainer — on simple stools, seen from behind or in profile, leaning in as if in dialogue. On the table: loose toy building bricks, a small half-built tower of bricks, and an open book with a quill writing by itself; both pages are completely blank. Beside the table stands a crystal orb on a slender tripod, tiny bricks assembling themselves inside it, and a fine ribbon of small bricks and sparks rising from the orb toward the bubbles. Above each seated figure floats a rounded thought bubble with two trailing dots, each holding a different idea assembling itself out of bricks — a bridge, a staircase, a ring of tiny figures holding hands. A thin thread rises from the table and passes through a small HOUSE UNDER CONSTRUCTION drawn in the middle distance — half-built walls of bricks with a partial roof — and continues beyond it to a globe of the Earth further back with simple continent outlines; the Earth has no bubble outline and no trailing dots, only the thread. The emerald glow starts in the orb, travels along the ribbon of bricks and settles in the half-built tower on the table.
